in_marathi.long_meaning: Balitvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Balitvansh is derived from Sanskrit words 'bal' meaning strength and 'tvansh' meaning lineage. This name is given to a boy born into a powerful, respected family or lineage.
